coverageRequirements.environment: Select supported browser/OS matrix before runtime work; unavailable required environments remain Not tested.
coverageRequirements.comparison: Compare functional results rather than serialized-tree identity. Scope method and tool capabilities independently.
coverageRequirements.applicability: Select applicable pattern states before counting coverage. Modal transitions and form submission states are not required for unrelated targets. Optional updates and nested popups apply only when supported.
